description: Change an existing schedule: pause it (enabled=false), resume it (enabled=true), or move when it runs. Pausing is the right answer when someone wants a schedule to stop for now; deleting throws away the setup. Any cadence field left out keeps its current value, so moving a daily run from 9am to 10am needs only hour=10. Get the schedule id from list_processes.

enabled.description: false pauses the schedule, true resumes it

name: update_schedule
